keyForm.weeklyLimitLabel: Weekly usage limit (USD, 0 = unlimited, rolling 7 days)
keyForm.allowModelsTitle: Due to a CPA upstream limitation, the plugin cannot filter the model list per key — only allow-all or 401.
keyForm.allowModelsHint: CPA cannot filter the model list per downstream key, so this is binary: allow (client sees the full global list) or 401 (hide it).
keyForm.priceLabel: Model unit price (USD / per million tokens; 0 = not billed)
keyForm.colBillingModeHint: Toggle to bill a fixed USD per successful request instead of by token count. Token prices are retained but dormant; untoggle to reuse them.
keyForm.billingModeTitle: Switch between per-token and per-call billing
keyForm.perCallZeroWarn: Per-call price is 0: calls are free (still counted). Fill in a price unless this is intentional.
keyForm.perCallImageWarn: Image/video endpoints (/v1/images, /v1/videos) are billed at admission time because CPA does not report usage for them — failed upstream requests are also charged.
keyForm.colCacheReadHint: Unit price for cache-hit input tokens (prompt-caching read). 0 = charged at the input price. Claude's cache-read tokens are separate from input and billed on their own; OpenAI/Gemini/Codex's cached tokens are a subset of input and are split out and re-billed at this price (no double counting).
keyForm.colRecommendHint: If this model has a reference price in the models.dev price DB, click to overwrite this row's three columns (input/output/cache-read) with it. Source is a community-maintained table, for reference only — verify as needed.
keyForm.recommendTitle: Fill this row from the models.dev community reference price
keyForm.syncPriceHint: Fetch current public prices from models.dev and replace token prices by exact model id.
keyForm.syncPriceDone: Synced {{matched}} / {{total}} models; unmatched rows were unchanged.
